content: We model the autocomplete system's decoding strategy $p_{\beta }(x\mid z)$ as a probabilistic model which conditions on the keywords $z$ and returns a distribution over predictions $x$. We use a standard sequence-to-sequence model with attention and copying for the decoder, but any model architecture can be used (see Appendix for details).
